about.subtitle: Frontend & SAP CAP Developer focused on React, TypeScript, SAP CAP, Cloud Foundry and clean implementation for corporate products.
about.text1: I can own the frontend part end to end: responsive UI, state management, forms, API integration, i18n, deployment and project support. My experience includes corporate websites, portals, Telegram Mini Apps, document platforms and interfaces for digital/game services.
about.text2: I am also developing in the SAP direction: SAP CAP, SAP BTP and Cloud Foundry. This makes me useful for roles that connect modern frontend delivery with enterprise backend integrations.
